bends.note: Vine changes direction at the Corry crossing: 90' N-S north of Corry, 60' diagonal SW south of it (to Calhoun and McMillan)
SW end of Douglas Alley turns west into the unnamed 15' alley that runs to Jefferson

notes: North is up. Printed names: 'W. CHARLTON', 'SCIOTO', 'ANDY', 'JEFFERSON AV.', 'ZELTNER', 'VINE', 'W. CORRY', 'THEIS ALLEY', 'DOUGLAS ALLEY', 'CLAASSEN', 'CALHOUN', 'W. McMILLAN'; suffix-less names written with 'Street'. Scioto lies on the binding at the left edge: its west line is in the gutter, so its centre (x~148) is taken from the east line (x~330) minus half the printed 60' (the water pipe runs ~40 px east of centre). Charlton's north line is on the 264 overlap at the top (y~90-110), south line ~470-500. ZELTNER (30') is the street that 264 calls Falke Street (264 says Falke continues south onto 262; the pipes line up at x~4330-4360): the name changes at Charlton, so that crossing is recorded under both names; Zeltner ends at Corry (T, lots 17-13 continuous). Andy ends at Corry (T). Vine is 90' north of Corry and turns SW as a 60' diagonal at the Corry crossing (east side is 'See Volume Four'); Corry continues east of Vine as East Corry (vol 4), recorded as both West and East Corry at the crossing as on 191 for McMillan. The SSE street leaving Vine just south of Corry (60', no name printed on this sheet) is Auburn Avenue per the volume 4 key map (it runs to Auburn/McMillan on sheet 191); point at the fork of the water pipes (~200 px south of the Corry crossing, the corner of the triangular lot is at 5720,3690). Douglas Alley (15') runs from Corry SSW (T at Corry) past Theis Alley (15', T: Theis runs from Jefferson east to Douglas) and at its SW end turns into an unnamed 15' alley running west to Jefferson (recorded under alleys; Jefferson/unnamed alley not in intersections because the alley is unnamed). Claassen (30') runs from Scioto (continues west onto 260) to Jefferson (T). Jefferson continues south of Calhoun (60') and ends at the Vine diagonal (T at 2990,7063); Calhoun ends at Vine (T). W. McMillan: north line y~7210, south line ~7575, centre ~7390 (two water pipes 7340/7420); it changes from West to East McMillan at Vine (vol 2 sheet 191 convention), recorded under both names. Scioto ends at McMillan (T, as on 260). 'BOWLING ALLEY' in block 7 is a building. Circled figures are grade elevations.
